commands.label: 清单哈希一致性复核（files 与 interfaces 的 SHA-256 与磁盘一致）
commands.command: python -B -c "import hashlib,json,pathlib;m=json.load(open('report/evidence/S4-D/s4d_spec_draft_20261021_r01/delivery_manifest.json',encoding='utf-8'));bad=[x['path'] for x in m['files']+m['interfaces'] if hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=x['sha256']];print('MISMATCH',len(bad));raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)"
